selection_basis: Independent September 2026 blind-listener benchmarks place Cartesia Sonic 3.6 at or near the top for perceived TTS quality; Eleven v3 remains the cinematic multi-speaker/dialogue specialist.

fallback.rule: Use existing verified local/pinned voice asset when ElevenLabs credentials, quota, voice IDs, generation, or QA fail.

acceptance: speaker voice IDs stay locked by character
no SFX or production directions appear in spoken text
best QA-scored premium take wins when multiple providers are available
routing: If both premium providers are configured: generate both and let transcript/audio QA select the take.
If only Cartesia is configured: use Sonic 3.6.
If only ElevenLabs is configured: use Eleven v3.
If neither premium provider passes readiness/QA: use the verified zero-credit fallback.
